correctness.rationale: Exact branchwise proof (equation (1)); root-common clade cancellation proves sufficiency. Alternating binomial finite difference annihilates all factorial moments through k=n-2, full extinction preserved by v_n=0, while (n-1)th clade probability shifts by +/-epsilon/n. Tree construction produces unique opposite optima by positive pendant advantage, epsilon/n sign, continuity in delta; precise four-tip rational witness checked by direct 16-subset enumeration. Finite check is not used as proof for all k.

value.rationale: The minimal order of joint-extinction information required to identify a unique conservation intervention is a natural structural decision question. The theorem sharply separates n<=k+1 guaranteed sufficiency from n=k+2 failure, even within exchangeable full-support scenarios and even if probability of all-taxa extinction is known. The explicit pairwise-independent four-tip counterexample shows why pairwise surveys cannot determine priority. Not an arbitrary small numerical variant or an empirical prediction.
